mapper.sql: select a.agent_id, a.user_id, a.agent_name, a.status, a.login_time, a.logout_time, a.last_login_ip, a.call_mode, a.current_call_id, a.current_call_phone, a.call_start_time, a.call_status, a.sip_extension, a.create_by, a.create_time, a.update_by, a.update_time, a.remark, u.user_name, u.nick_name, u.phonenumber, d.dept_name from ai_call_agent_status a left join sys_user u on a.user_id = u.user_id left join sys_dept d on u.dept_id = d.dept_id
